message: No detected input validation: The code only checks for file/directory existence and raises FileNotFoundError, but performs no schema, dtype, or value-range validation on the actual data loaded from disk or arguments beyond boolean/list parsing.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local disk via load_from_disk and glob without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or source authentication for any remote resources.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data-flow path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads datasets directly from disk via load_from_disk/load_dataset with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering applied to training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model checkpoints via get_last_checkpoint() and AutoConfig/AutoModel/AutoTokenizer without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision to ensure integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets and passes them directly to the trainer without any label distribution checks, class balance verification, or anomalous sample detection.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any mechanism to prevent metric manipulation; evaluation data is loaded directly from disk without integrity verification.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads datasets and passes them directly to the retriever and reader without any shape, range, or schema validation of the inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (EM, F1 scores, predictions) are used and reported directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline uses a reading comprehension model (text-in/text-out), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the code.
